name: Enable or disable a season map
description: Admin only: `{"enabled": true}` puts a board in play and `false` takes it out, at any time before the close -- THE ONE PART OF A SEASON THAT CHANGES WHILE IT IS LIVE (N28). There is no delete: a board is public from its upload and the matches played on it name it. ENABLING runs the engine on the board again, because an engine patch moves a live season's digest and a board this node's engine refuses must not be paired. DISABLING cancels, in the same statement, the matches on it nobody has claimed (withdrawn_reason MAP_DISABLED); a claimed or running one finishes and is counted, because it was paired and played fairly on a board that was in play. A cancelled trial is re-paired on the next board by the rule that already handles one. Each flip writes a season_map_events row, the record of which boards a live season's ratings were earned on. Asking for the state a board is already in changes nothing and answers 200 with it.

with.name: Admins only
with.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

body.detail: The body is {"enabled": true} or {"enabled": false}.

tasks.name: The map, its season, and the engines

input.query: SELECT json_build_object( 'found', true, 'closed', se.closed_at IS NOT NULL, 'players', sm.players, 'board', sm.board, 'engine', json_build_object('season', se.engine_digest, 'node', ($4)::text), 'engine_ok', se.engine_digest = ($4)::text) AS body FROM season_maps sm JOIN seasons se ON se.id = sm.season_id JOIN games g ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND sm.map_id = ($3)::text

tasks.name: Flip it, and cancel what a disable leaves queued

input.query: WITH target AS ( SELECT sm.id FROM season_maps sm JOIN seasons se ON se.id = sm.season_id JOIN games g ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND sm.map_id = ($3)::text AND se.closed_at IS NULL AND sm.enabled IS DISTINCT FROM ($4)::boolean FOR UPDATE OF sm ), flipped AS ( UPDATE season_maps sm SET enabled = ($4)::boolean FROM target WHERE sm.id = target.id RETURNING sm.id ), cancelled AS ( UPDATE matches m SET status = 'cancelled', withdrawn_reason = 'MAP_DISABLED', closed_at = now() FROM flipped WHERE NOT ($4)::boolean AND m.season_map_id = flipped.id AND m.status = 'pending' RETURNING m.id ) INSERT INTO season_map_events (season_map_id, enabled, by_user, cancelled) SELECT flipped.id, ($4)::boolean, ($5)::uuid, (SELECT count(*) FROM cancelled) FROM flipped

SELECT season_map_json(sm) AS body FROM season_maps sm JOIN seasons se ON se.id = sm.season_id JOIN games g ON g.id = se.game_id WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text AND se.slug = ($2)::text AND sm.map_id = ($3)::text
